haiku-low.q1: The old engine charges and writes the ledger. The new engine's invoices go to the shadow store, uncharged.
haiku-low.q2: The new engine charges and writes the ledger. The old engine keeps computing every invoice into the shadow store without charging.
haiku-low.q3: Seven consecutive clean days with comparison rows on every day, then a person sets billing_mode to both.
haiku-low.q4: The billing monitor, when the new engine's charge failure rate exceeds 2% over any 10-minute window. This happens in both or new_only.
haiku-low.q5: Every rollback ends in old_only. A person must set the flag to shadow again, and all gates reset, restarting the 7-day count.
haiku-low.q6: After day 35 from becoming new_only, because the usage event log keeps only 35 days and the old engine could not reprocess skipped events.
haiku-low.q8: In comparison_results. The rollout tool refuses any forward move whose gate has not passed, so the mode stays.
haiku-low.q9: The billing monitor measures the new engine's charge failure rate. Above 2% in any 10-minute window, it starts a rollback.
haiku-low.q10: Due charges stay uncharged in the ledger until reconcile charges them. Usage events are logged. Normal charging waits until resume_charging.
haiku-low.q11: Reconcile checks the ledger before every charge, so a repeated run cannot charge a period twice. Existing ledger charges stand.
haiku-low.q12: Billing is left with that step not marked done in the rollback record. The rollout tool retries, resuming at the first step not marked done.

sonnet.q1: The old engine charges and writes the ledger. The new engine's invoices go to the shadow store (never charged, never written to the ledger).
sonnet.q2: The new engine charges and writes the ledger. The old engine keeps computing every invoice into the shadow store without charging, so it stays current.
sonnet.q3: 7 consecutive clean days (mismatch rate under 0.1% with at least 5,000 invoices compared; a night with no comparison is not clean). A person sets billing_mode to both, and the rollout tool refuses if the gate has not passed.
sonnet.q4: The billing monitor, when the new engine's charge failure rate is above 2% over any 10-minute window, in both or new_only (before day 35). Shadow errors never start one.
sonnet.q5: Every rollback ends in old_only (set by resume_charging). Before the new engine can take over again, a person must set the flag to shadow again and the gates restart: 7 clean days counted from that day, then both, etc. Earlier clean days do not count.
sonnet.q6: From day 35 (counted from the day billing_mode became new_only) rollback is no longer possible, because the usage event log keeps only 35 days of events, so the old engine could not reprocess the events it skipped.
sonnet.q7: Each engine reads billing_mode and acts as its mode says. NOT STATED for how workers detect the change (polling/push) or what happens to an invoice being processed at that moment.
sonnet.q8: In comparison_results (written by the nightly comparison job); the rollout tool computes the gate from it and refuses the move (mode stays) if the gate has not passed.
sonnet.q9: The billing monitor. It measures the new engine's charge failure rate (share of its charges that fail) over 10-minute windows; when above 2% in both or new_only, it starts a rollback.
sonnet.q10: Due charges already in the ledger stay uncharged after pause_charging until reconcile. Reconcile (step 4, run by the old engine) charges periods the new engine never wrote to the ledger, at the old engine's invoice amount, after checking the ledger. Charges falling due after reconcile but before resume_charging: NOT STATED (listed as an open question).
sonnet.q11: Reconcile leaves any period the ledger already shows as charged alone, and checks the ledger before every charge, so a repeated run cannot charge a period twice. A difference on a charged period is recorded as a mismatch; the ledger's charge stands, with no refund and no second charge.
sonnet.q12: billing_mode keeps the old mode until resume_charging completes; progress is held in the rollback record with each step marked done or not started, and charging stays paused/under the rollback's charging engine. The failed step is retried, and the retry resumes at the first step not marked done. Retry limit is NOT STATED.
